tool.name: Biomni: Track Immune Cells Under Flow
tool.description: Track immune cells under flow conditions and classify their behaviors.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Track Immune Cells Under Flow**
Track immune cells under flow conditions and classify their behaviors.
Args: image_sequence_path (str): Path to image sequence directory or video file. output_dir (str): Directory to save output files. pixel_size_um (float): Pixel size in micrometers. time_interval_sec (float): Time interval between frames in seconds. flow_direction (str): Direction of flow ('right', 'left', 'up', 'down').
Returns: str: Log of the analysis process.
**Domain**: immunology **Function**: track_immune_cells_under_flow
